verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase is documented as a serverless framework that runs backend code in response to HTTPS requests, the Admin SDK, background events, or Cloud Scheduler jobs. Code deploys with one CLI command and Firebase automatically scales compute, so there are no servers to manage. A community user independently reports running production APIs solely on Firebase Functions with Firestore. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of client-SDK invocation (e.g. callable functions from app SDKs) beyond the Admin SDK trigger.
